title: Property Unit
description: One bounded volume with an identity, a classification, a lifecycle position and a paper trail. Owned by P4. Consumed by P1 (review screen), P5 (viewer), P6 (export).

unit_id.description: Opaque identity. Allocated once, never derived, never reused, never changes.

ulpin.description: Frozen at approval and bound to unit_id forever. NULL until status=approved.

ulpin_provisional.description: Recomputed freely while the unit is provisional. Discarded at approval.

dispute_state.description: Legal contestation. Deliberately separate from validation_state, which is geometric.

representation.description: v1 is prism-only: footprint extruded between lower_limit and upper_limit.

lower_limit.description: Metres in vertical_datum. NULL means unknown - never guess.

source_ids.description: FK to P2's source registry. Drives the validation tolerance for this unit.

valid_from.description: When this was true on the ground.

attributes.description: Type-specific. Keys below are the recognised ones; unknown keys are preserved but ignored.

subdivided.description: false = no interior data; apartments deliberately not created.

plinth_offset_m.description: Buildings sit above surrounding ground; the ground floor slab is not at DEM level.

easement.description: true for utilities/tunnels: may legitimately overlap parcels.

then.description: Approval freezes the ULPIN binding. An approved unit always has one.
FR-05: every AI-originated unit carries its confidence and model provenance.

polygon.description: GeoJSON Polygon geometry, but coordinates are in the unit's projected `crs` (metres), NOT WGS84. Deliberate deviation from RFC 7946 - P4 does area and distance maths and must not reproject per operation.
